functions: stopAtWall (b4): obstacle check, then drive forward or followLine
followLine (b10): curve left on black, else curve right
control_flow: stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, drive forward at 10 % without end; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.
